ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Rust Cathedral Hum
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUST_CATHEDRAL_MECHANICS_1 §1 (the hum-mood system). Builds the attitude value, layered tones, droid commentary and hysteresis wiring the_rust_cathedral.md and its kit spec promise: mine the bulk freely and the hum stays a warm drone; hook an eel, crack a strange wall, or park a drill and a new tone slides in under the first, then another; push on and the hum drops to silence — the survival cue to stop moving.
- RM_BiomeAttitudeDef (new Def type) + RM_MapComponent_BiomeAttitude (new MapComponent, auto-added to every map, no-ops off the Rust Cathedral): tracks a decaying "irritation" float, composites it against LIVE faction-13 (Forsaken/Forgotten Arsenal, vanilla Mechanoid) player goodwill into a 0-4 band, with a de-escalation-only hysteresis margin so the band doesn't chatter at a cutoff. - Band drives: 1-3 layered ambient Sustainers (RUT_HumLayerDrone/Tense/Alarm, placeholder audio reusing vanilla mechanoid-ambient clips — no audio pipeline exists in this repo, same "placeholder, reuse vanilla" convention RustCathedralWalls used for art), full silence at the worst band, a cooldown-gated §P-register droid-commentary message on band transitions (only fires with a player-faction mechanoid pawn on the map), and a capped sustained-worst-band drain on faction-13 goodwill (the ledger's own -75/0 hostility hysteresis is unmodified vanilla — this mod only nudges the number that feeds it). - RUT_RustCathedralAttitude: the one content instance, targeting RUT_RustCathedral.
Public API for the rest of the kit to plug into: RM_MapComponent_BiomeAttitude.GetBand(Map) RM_MapComponent_BiomeAttitude.AddIrritation(Map, float) §3, §4 and §5 (below) are all consumers.
ALSO HERE: §3 (living bolts as mechanical wildlife) — the hum's display organ, built into this mod rather than a sibling because it is the only thing that reads the band, and §1's own spec section describes the bolt-dance display as part of the hum system. - RUT_LivingBolt (ThingDef + PawnKindDef + its own RUT_BoltFrame BodyDef): a tiny mechanoid-fleshed wild critter on §6's live-verified BaseMechanoidWalker shape. Mechanoid flesh settles three requirements at once — not butcherable into meat, no taming route (RaceProperties.Animal is false for any mechanoid, so trainability may stay null with no config error), and butcherProducts must be non-empty, which Steel 2 supplies. It costs the Hunt designator, which only offers animals; killing a bolt is still possible by draft, and that is what the watched pricing charges for. NO wildBiomes entry — the roster JSON owns the cast, this owns the shape. - RUT_ThinkTree_LivingBolt: its own main think tree, because the inherited vanilla Mechanoid tree has no insertTag anywhere and is built for lords and overseers. Order is the mechanism: the freeze conditional outranks the queued figure, which outranks the dance, which outranks vanilla wander (the all-off floor). - RM_ThinkNode_ConditionalAttitudeBand + RM_JobGiver_ResonantDance: the freeze and the dance. Figures are short chains of vanilla Goto jobs on generated loops/lobed figures/alignments; pattern energy is full at band 0 and nothing at band 4, and the freeze fires at band 4 — where §1 kills every sustainer. NOTE the kit spec's pre-§1 wording says "freeze at band 0"; §1 shipped band 0 = calmest, so this follows the sheet's MEANING ("when the hum drops, stop moving") and keeps both numbers in the think tree XML. - RUT_BoltShedCuriosity: a salable trade good dropped every 4-8 days by vanilla CompSpawner on the race — no new comp. - Watched pricing: Harmony postfixes on Pawn_CarryTracker.TryStartCarry (both overloads) and a prefix on Pawn.Kill add +3 / +15 irritation, but only when a player-faction pawn did it. Nothing player-readable says so — the sheet's ban 1 forbids the def admitting it is watched.
ALSO HERE: §4 (eel-fishing consequences) — Odyssey's fishing stack, priced. - RUT_CoolantEel: the SOLE entry in the Cathedral's freshwater fishTypes, so every canal catch is an eel. Salable (MarketValue 18), as the sheet says. Saltwater stays empty and no rare-catch table is set, so "canal only" is structural rather than a rule someone has to remember. - A biome patch supplies maxFishPopulation (150) as well as fishTypes. That is not decoration: the Cathedral biome shipped with it at 0, and at 0 WaterBodyTracker skips its population tick and Zone_Fishing refuses to exist. Without it §4 is dead content. (Canals below ~75 cells still hold no fish at all — vanilla's body-size curve, not ours.) - The line-in tell is the kit spec's own preferred zero-Harmony route: §1's MapComponent reads the fishing STATE off the map's own pawns on its existing 250-tick interval, +5 irritation once per fishing job, colony pawns only. The Harmony fallback the spec offers was not needed. - The per-catch price is a Harmony postfix on WaterBodyTracker.Notify_Fished (+2 irritation per fish, -1 faction-13 goodwill per 3 fish in a day). A catch is an INSTANT, not a state — an interval scan structurally cannot see it. - RUT_NegativeFishingOutcome_CoolantEel: one vanilla NegativeFishingOutcome, ElectricalBurn 8~14 and an undescribing letter, behind vanilla's own 2% roll and 5-day map cooldown (re-read from FishingUtility at build — note the class's NegativeCatchCooldownTicks constant is dead; the executed code uses a 300000-tick literal).
ALSO HERE: §5 (the deep-drill response event) — ban 6 territory, so nothing player-readable describes it. - RUT_DeepDrillCathedralResponse + RUT_IncidentWorker_CathedralResponse: fires only on a Rust Cathedral map with a usable player deep drill sitting over RUT_LivePatternMetal (§2's tier 4, resolved by defName — no cross-mod reference). A faction-13 force at 2-3x scaled points converges on that drill under vanilla LordJob_AssaultThings, destroys it, and withdraws; it never takes an assault-colony lord, so "movement against the violation, not an assault on the colony" is structural. Firing also floors the §1 band and takes -25 goodwill. - No storyteller plumbing of our own: vanilla's StorytellerComp_DeepDrillInfestation already rolls this category. Its pick is an UNWEIGHTED TryRandomElement, so the spec's ❓ is answered "no, it would be a coin flip" — and the spec's own named fallback is taken: a Harmony postfix refuses vanilla's bug infestation on Cathedral maps only.
Deferred (kit spec's own scope lines): the -15-per-sacred-building magnitude check on vanilla's AttackedBuilding goodwill hook (rides whichever mod ends up owning Tier 3 enforcement — noted, not stubbed, here); hum-literacy as a learnable/tradeable knowledge item; per-colonist mood thought; the line-cycle ambient dressing event; real authored hum audio (placeholder clips only); and for §3, dance choreography variety, synchronized multi-bolt figures, fleck/sound garnish, and real bolt art (placeholder texPaths only — expect magenta until the art pipe runs). §2 (wall tiers) and §6 (roaches) are built in sibling mods; §4/§5 of the kit are untouched.
